How it works

What the Challenge actually is

For 30 days, starting August 10, I hand you the path.

What to write. When to post. How to grow. How to turn quiet readers into paying subscribers. One clear step at a time.

No more staring at the blank page like it's a locked door. You open the day's prompt the way you open the garden gate in the morning, and you tend the one thing in front of you.

And here is the part I love most. The whole thing happens right here on Substack.

Each morning, a prompt lands softly in your DMs. The teaching comes as short audios, warm in your ear while you make your coffee or drive the kids to school. My voice, walking with you, one day at a time.

No new login. No course platform to wrestle. No seventeen tabs bleeding you dry. You subscribe, and the next morning we begin.

And you are not doing this alone in the dark. You are doing it on a clock, with me, alongside a whole room of women building right beside you — each one lighting her own window, all of you rising together.

That is what turns "I set up a Substack" into "I have a Substack that pays me."

The Challenge is your first 30 days inside the Affluent Creator Circle. When the 30 days end, the Circle keeps going. And so, gorgeous, do you.
